industries.medicalWellness.title: Healthcare robots: disinfection | Professional Robotics
industries.medicalWellness.description: Robots for clinics and wellness centers: delivering lab samples and medication, disinfecting rooms, rehabilitation. We relieve staff and keep hygiene standards.
industries.medicalWellness.name: Healthcare and wellness
industries.medicalWellness.lead: A clinic is full of routine work that takes time away from medical staff: running lab samples and medication, disinfecting rooms, delivering linen.
industries.medicalWellness.lead2: Robots take over this logistics. Staff focus on patients, and hygiene procedures run to standard with nothing skipped.
industries.medicalWellness.photo.alt: Autonomous hospital cart driving down a ward corridor
industries.medicalWellness.compliance: Medical use requires checking the equipment’s certification and registration in Russia. We don’t promise medical functions without confirmed approval documents, and we select equipment in line with the facility’s requirements.
industries.medicalWellness.heads.problem: Where a clinic loses staff time.
industries.medicalWellness.problems.item: Internal logistics eats up time that is already in short supply.
Requirements are strict, and the human factor leads to gaps.
Delivery and cleaning run at night too, but staff is limited.
Not enough specialists or equipment for patient recovery.
industries.medicalWellness.route.title: Robots deliver, staff treat.
industries.medicalWellness.route.lead: Internal logistics is the easiest place to start: the route is clear, and the impact shows within the first weeks.
lab samples on schedule and on call
industries.medicalWellness.route.diagram: Clinic floor plan: the robot takes medication from the pharmacy to the wards and lab samples to the laboratory along the corridor and via the elevator
industries.medicalWellness.directions.it: Lab samples, medication, linen and supplies between departments, on schedule and on call.
Disinfection robots for wards, operating rooms and common areas, following protocol, with a report on every pass.

industries.medicalWellness.pilot.items.2: Other departments, night shifts, disinfection by protocol.
